localidad: Central Valle de Anchicaya, off Valle del Cauca
comentarios: Presumably the first recording at XC for this species in Colombia and the first of this ssp.  Bird had arrived in the bush approx. 8min previously, but was not seen subsequently.  Then it briefly started calling for some 10sec, of which the first 4sec (very similar in calls) were missed for recording.  At end of recording, the bird flew off. Not due to harassment, I believe.
